integrity: The theorem derives the 8+8 Pauli-sector singular spectra from a Gaussian-reference Choi state and an explicit Majorana-conjugation overlap. The continuum proof uses exact two-by-two singular-value identities. The bundled checker reconstructs finite matrices independently for corroboration, not as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for the normalized four-mode fermionic Choi state of a parity-preserving two-qubit unitary followed by independent product depolarizing channels. No claim about channel resource preservation for arbitrary ancillas, circuit simulation, or fault-tolerant thresholds. Correlated noise and larger gates are not covered.
title: Exact asymmetric-depolarization Choi phase diagram for fermionic gates
